get.description: List the operations for the Microsoft.Offers resource provider.

Get a single availability by its identifier. The catalog is globally keyed:
the same `availabilityId` returns the same response for all callers under
one API version.

post.description:
Look up a single enumeration set by its type key (for example,
`categories`). The catalog is globally keyed: the same `enumerationType`
returns the same response for all callers under one API version. Modeled
as a POST action because the response is identical for every caller in a
subscription and the catalog is not a per-subscription resource
collection.

get.description:
Get a single product by its identifier. The catalog is globally keyed: the
same `productId` returns the same response for all callers under one API
version.

Get a single SKU by its identifier. The catalog is globally keyed: the same
`skuId` returns the same response for all callers under one API version.

Get a single value-exchange (UPN) by its identifier. The catalog is
globally keyed: the same `valueExchangeId` returns the same response for
all callers under one API version.

Availability.description: Availability information for a value exchange.

availabilityId.description: The stable availability identifier (typically equal to the value-exchange id).

markets.description: Markets in which this availability is offered (ISO 3166 country codes).

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modified date for the availability record.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the availability applies.

terms.description: Purchase terms offered by this availability.

supportedLanguages.description: Synthesized intersection of the SKU's market properties and the availability's markets.

meters.description: Synthesized subset of the SKU's meter data filtered by the availability's meter type.

properties.description: Curated availability property subset projected from the upstream catalog.

AvailabilityConditions.description: Conditions under which the availability applies.

startDate.description: Start date of the availability window.

endDate.description: End date of the availability window. The upstream `9999-...` sentinel is scrubbed to null.

AvailabilityMeter.description: A meter bound to this value exchange (synthesized from the upstream meter data, filtered by meter type).

AvailabilityNameParameter.description: The name of the availability (its catalog identifier).

AvailabilityProperties.description: Flat properties of an availability, matching the `availabilities` stream.

productId.description: Foreign key linking to the parent product.

version.description: Product version propagated from the parent product document.

skuId.description: Foreign key linking to the parent SKU.

displayRank.description: Numeric rank for determining display ordering of availabilities.

affirmationId.description: Identifier for the legal/compliance affirmation required at purchase time.

consumptionUnitType.description: Consumption unit type feeding the canonical granted-by-scope unit (for example, `PTU`).

actions.description: Available purchase/fulfillment actions for this availability.

propertiesEnvelope.description: Full availability properties bag containing extended metadata.

conditions.description: Verbatim eligibility-evaluation envelope kept as one decision unit.

orderManagementData.description: Order management data at the availability level.

termIds.description: Array of term identifiers applicable to this availability.

markets.description: Markets in which this availability is offered.

availabilityPolicies.description: Policies governing this availability (cancellation, refund, etc.).

pricingRuleIds.description: Pricing rule identifiers used to compute the price for this availability.

assetsData.description: Digital asset data associated with this availability's fulfillment.

diagnosticsInformation.description: Dynamic struct containing provenance and internal routing fields.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the catalog resource.

AvailabilityTerm.description: A purchase term offered by an availability.

termUnits.description: ISO-8601 duration for the term (for example, "P1Y").

Azure.ResourceManager.ResourceProvisioni.description: The provisioning state of a resource type.

CatalogAvailability.description: An availability in the commerce catalog.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

CatalogProduct.description: A product in the commerce catalog.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

CatalogSku.description: A SKU in the commerce catalog.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

allowedPlatforms.description: Allowed client platforms; empty list means no platform restriction.

LookupEnumerationRequest.description: Request body for looking up an enumeration set by its type key.

LookupEnumerationResult.description: The result of an enumeration lookup.

enumerationType.description: The enumeration type key the result corresponds to.

values.description: The enumeration values. Values are passed through verbatim from the upstream catalog feed.

PcdPropertyBag.description: A curated property bag projected from the upstream catalog. Unbounded key set.

Product.description: Denormalized product summary for a value exchange.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modified date for the product record.

publisherName.description: Lifted single-language publisher name from the upstream catalog feed.

properties.description: Curated product property subset projected from the upstream catalog.

ProductNameParameter.description: The name of the product (its catalog identifier).

ProductProperties.description: Flat properties of a product, matching the `products` stream.

version.description: Integer version of the product document.

productFamily.description: The family or category grouping to which this product belongs (for example, Azure, Microsoft 365).

productType.description: Classifies the product type within the commerce platform (for example, Platform, SaaS, DevTool).

lineOfBusiness.description: The line of business under which this product falls. Defaults to `Azure` when not explicitly set.

ownershipSellingMotion.description: Primary selling motion / ownership model for the product.

serviceFamilyName.description: Service family grouping used for reporting and categorization (for example, Compute, Storage, Networking).

serviceName.description: The specific Azure/commerce service this product belongs to.

isMicrosoftProduct.description: Indicates whether this is a first-party Microsoft product (true) or a third-party/ISV product (false).

isTestProduct.description: Indicates whether this product is designated as a test product and excluded from production reporting.

sellerId.description: Identifier of the seller or publisher offering this product in the marketplace.

eligibility.description: Eligibility rules and constraints at the product level.

consumption.description: Consumption model information for the product, including meter and term definitions.

pricing.description: Pricing model and configuration data at the product level.

policies.description: Product-level policies governing purchasing, renewal, and lifecycle behavior.

alternateIds.description: Alternate identifiers for cross-referencing this product across systems.

marketProperties.description: Market-specific properties (pricing, availability per market) at the product level.

localizedProperties.description: Localized display properties (title, description) in multiple languages at the product level.

propertiesEnvelope.description: Whole `Product.Properties` envelope captured verbatim as a loss-free fallback.

displayName.description: Display name of the product, promoted from localized properties.

publisherName.description: Name of the publisher, promoted from localized properties.

diagnosticsInformation.description: Dynamic struct containing low-traffic provenance and internal routing fields.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the catalog resource.

Sku.description: Denormalized SKU summary for a value exchange.

productId.description: The product identifier this SKU belongs to.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modified date for the SKU record.

properties.description: Curated SKU property subset projected from the upstream catalog. Includes partner channel and deactivated lifecycle state.

SkuNameParameter.description: The name of the SKU (its catalog identifier within the product).

SkuProperties.description: Flat properties of a SKU, matching the `skus` stream.

productId.description: Foreign key linking this SKU to its parent product.

version.description: Product version propagated from the parent product document.

skuType.description: Classification of the SKU type within the commerce platform.

fulfillmentType.description: Describes how the SKU is fulfilled (for example, license key, SaaS provisioning, physical delivery).

isTrial.description: Indicates whether this SKU represents a trial/evaluation offering.

isPreOrder.description: Indicates whether this SKU is available for pre-order before general availability.

isBundle.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a bundle composed of multiple child SKUs.

minOrderQuantity.description: Minimum quantity that can be ordered for this SKU in a single transaction.

maxOrderQuantity.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered for this SKU in a single transaction.

fulfillmentData.description: Fulfillment-specific data including provisioning URIs and delivery instructions.

orderManagementData.description: Order management data at the SKU level.

benefitGroupId.description: Cross-PCD benefit join key (FCP = SKU UPN, P3 = ProductId).

location.description: Location scope for region-scoped benefit grants (ASP / autofit).

armRegionName.description: ARM region name for region-scoped benefit grants.

attributes.description: SKU-level attributes / autofit reservation key-value data.

meterIds.description: Meter identifier array used for meter/resource joins.

benefits.description: Benefits associated with this SKU (for example, entitlements, feature access).

constraintsData.description: Constraint rules governing SKU eligibility and purchasing restrictions.

marketProperties.description: Market-specific properties at the SKU level (availability, pricing overrides per market).

localizedProperties.description: Localized display properties at the SKU level in multiple languages.

reservationOfferConfiguration.description: Legacy P3 reservation block retained for round-trip under the new model.

propertiesEnvelope.description: Whole `Sku.Properties` envelope captured verbatim as a loss-free fallback.

skuTitle.description: Display title of the SKU, promoted from localized properties.

language.description: Default language code for the SKU's localized content.

diagnosticsInformation.description: Dynamic struct containing provenance and internal routing fields.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the catalog resource.

ValueExchange.description: A value exchange (UPN) in the commerce catalog.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

ValueExchangeNameParameter.description: The name of the value exchange (its UPN identifier).

ValueExchangeProperties.description:
Properties of a value exchange (UPN). Wraps the denormalized trio of
Product, Sku, and Availability. Slim shape: large blobs (raw meter data,
order management data, passthrough sub-objects, co-sell, attributes) are
dropped here and live on the rich hydrate response.

productId.description: Foreign key linking to the parent product.

skuId.description: Foreign key linking to the parent SKU.

valueExchangeId.description: Primary key — the Universal Product Number (UPN) identifying this value exchange / meter.

version.description: Product version propagated from the parent product document.

productCode.description: Consumer-facing alias of the UPN (same source value as `valueExchangeId`).

meterType.description: Classification of the meter type (for example, consumption, license seat, reservation).

termId.description: Identifier of the associated billing term for this value exchange.

saasRenewTermId.description: SaaS-specific renewal term identifier for automatic renewal routing.

termUnits.description: Units of the term (for example, monthly, annually), resolved via lookup in Product.Consumption.Terms[].

termDescriptionId.description: Descriptive identifier for the term, resolved via enrichment lookup.

termComponentIds.description: Array of term component identifiers that compose this billing term.

renewalQuoteTimer.description: Timer value (in days) for generating renewal quotes prior to term end.

productLifecycleStates.description: Array of lifecycle states applicable to this product/term combination.

availabilityIds.description: Array of availability identifiers matching this value exchange's skuId + termId.

availabilityCount.description: Count of matching availability records for this value exchange.

diagnosticsInformation.description: Dynamic struct carrying internal-routing provenance fields (for example, `runId`).

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the catalog resource.
